instruction: I want to increase the maximum volume limit in VLC to 200%. The default 125% isn't loud enough for my needs. How do I change this setting?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's maximum volume setting to 200 (qt-max-volume=200). Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric to verify the setting in vlcrc config file. Default is 125, task sets it to 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can fully verify the instruction

Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses config file and verifies qt-max-volume setting equals 200
Expected value (200) matches instruction requirement to increase max volume to 200%
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter (accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] directly, not rule.get('rules', {}))
Edge cases handled: file not found (try/except), missing setting (defaults to '125'), type conversion (int to str)
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing max volume to 200%, evaluator checks exactly this
